# Responsive Viewer — Mobile & Tablet Simulator
> The official free Chrome Extension and web testing suite for previewing responsive websites across 77+ real smartphone, tablet, foldable, and desktop screen sizes.

## Overview
Responsive Viewer — Mobile & Tablet Simulator (Chrome Extension ID: olejimcjikeollilnoncliiobdecmpin) is a free developer tool designed for web developers, UI/UX designers, and QA engineers. It enables instant simulation of responsive web pages on over 77 physical device frames with accurate CSS viewports, device pixel ratios (DPR), touch event emulation, and transparent mockup PNG downloads.

## Direct Chrome Web Store Link
- Extension URL: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/responsive-viewer-%E2%80%94-mobil/olejimcjikeollilnoncliiobdecmpin
- Official Website: https://mobile-simulator-web.vercel.app

## Key Capabilities
- **77+ Mobile, Tablet, and Foldable Devices**: Includes Apple iPhone (iPhone 18 Pro, 17, 16, 15, 14, SE), Samsung Galaxy (S26 Ultra, S25, S24, Z Fold), Google Pixel (Pixel 10 Pro Fold, 9, 8), Xiaomi, Huawei, Apple Watch, iPad, and MacBook.
- **100% Free & Unlocked**: Zero subscription fees, zero pro paywalls, and zero ads. All device frames and developer tools are completely unlocked.
- **Accurate CSS Viewports & DPR**: Emulates exact CSS width, height, and DPR for accurate CSS media query triggering.
- **Mockup PNG Downloads**: High-resolution transparent PNG frames ready for Figma, Photoshop, and portfolio presentations.
- **Localhost & File Testing**: Works out of the box with localhost:3000, 127.0.0.1, Next.js, Vite, Live Server, and file:/// URLs.
- **Full Privacy**: 100% local in-browser execution with zero telemetry or data harvesting.
